relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with capsazepine (1 mg/kg), transient receptor potential vanilloid 1- antagonist blocked the hypotensive (5%), bradycardiac (1.2%), tachypnoeic (6%) and hyperventilatory (6%) responses significantly.

relationships.subject: ondansetron
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with ondansetron (100 μg/kg), 5-HT3-antagonist attenuated the hypotensive (10%), bradycardiac (1.7%), tachypnoeic (11%) and hyperventilatory (11%) responses significantly.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Instillation of bradykinin produced immediate hypotensive (40%), bradycardiac (17%), tachypnoeic (45%) and hyperventilatory (96%) responses of shorter latencies (5-8 s)

key_findings: Intra-arterial bradykinin evokes cardiorespiratory reflexes in rats that are attenuated by TRPV1 (capsazepine) and 5-HT3 (ondansetron) antagonism
